tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: b. The bidder should have an experience of 3 years in manufacturing and supply of tendered material. Document to be uploaded: Bidder shall upload self-attested copies of the Purchase Order & Performance Certificate pertaining to that PO only, issued from KPTCL/DISCOMs/Govt. utilities of State/Electricity boards in India or any Central Government undertakings, certified by official not below the rank of Executive Engineer/DGM or equivalent rank

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Valid documents as mentioned in criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: c.The bidder should have supplied at least 40% of tendered material in any one of the previous three years (2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25) to the ESCOM/KPTCL/Govt. Utilities of State/Electricity boards in India or Central Government undertakings. Document to be uploaded: Bidder shall upload self-attested copies of the Purchase Order & Supply Certificate pertaining to that PO only, issued from KPTCL/DISCOMs/Govt. utilities of State/Electricity boards in India or any Central Government undertakings, certified by official not below the rank of Executive Engineer/DGM or equivalent rank.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Valid document as mentioned in criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: d.The bidder shall have the capacity to manufacture and supply at least 25% of the tendered quantity per month. Document to be uploaded: The bidder shall submit a duly notarized affidavit on a non-judicial stamp paper of Rs 500 value declaring the required details.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Valid document as mentioned in criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: f.The Annual Turnover of the bidder shall be at least 50% of the amount put to tender in any one of the previous three financial years i.e., (2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25). Copies of the audited annual accounts and P&L statements certified by a Chartered Accountant with a valid Unique Documents Identification No (UDIN) shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: g.The bidder should have liquid asset (cash at bank and Term Deposits) or availability of credit facilities of not less than 12.5% of amount put to tender. This must be supported by credit lines, letter of credit certificate from nationalized/scheduled/ commercial banks for meeting the fund requirement. The certificate of bank shall not be dated earlier than 30 Days prior to the last date of submission of the tender.

a.The Bidder should be a MSME manufacturer of the tendered material and should have registered and obtained factory license from the State Directorate of factory & Industrial safety, Boiler and health.For MSME, an Enterprise shall be registered with Director of Industries and Commerce, GOK as Micro & Small enterprises, under Micro, small & Medium Enterprises development Act-2006.Document to be uploaded: The bidder shall submit copy of self-attested factory license and the valid certificate issued by the Director of Industries & Commerce, GOK confirming that, the firm is registered as a Micro, small or Medium Enterprises (MSME)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Valid certificate as per criterion

Document to be uploaded: The bidder shall submit a duly notarized affidavit on a non-judicial stamp paper of Rs 500 value declaring the required details.
